clips.title: The story
paras: In Sen'jin Village, Kali Remik guides young hunters toward their next training. She is a Darkspear troll hunter who knows the tracking and survival ways of Durotar.

Kali Remik guides young scouts in Sen'jin Village, where they begin their lives beyond the Valley of Trials. A Darkspear troll tracker, she knows Durotar's dry lands and the Horde's settlements. When a novice is ready to leave the local training grounds, Kali sends promising hunters to Thotar in Razor Hill. There they begin learning to tame beasts, strengthening the Horde's frontier ranks.
